thread:
marco: Seeing a weird cross-region tail in eu-west after we routed some dedicated tenants to eu-central for warm-pool capacity. p95 spikes only for tenants routed across regions.
anya: same. Traces show extra RTT + occasional TLS handshake failures when routing crosses region boundary to kv-primary-eu-central. Looks like asymmetric egress + NAT mapping issues.
drew: ops-bot reported NAT stickiness mismatch: nat-gw-eu-central sometimes SNATs back to ephemeral ports that eu-west nodes don't accept for return traffic due to asymmetric routing policy.
ops-bot: ALERT: cross-region-egress-unstable 12: nat-mapping-inconsistency detected (eu-west <-> eu-central).
marco: Example flow: client in eu-west -> our service (eu-west) -> outbound to kv in eu-central. Return path sometimes goes through a different NAT GW and the conntrack doesn't match -> RSTs.
anya: Short-term mitigation: prefer intra-region routing for outbound to region-local kv replicas. If we must cross-region, pin nat-gw both ways (egress+ingress symmetry) or use a proxy to preserve source.
drew: Can flip routing to use dedicated nat-gw pair per tenant when cross-region is required. That adds operational cost but is less disruptive than client errors.
infra-oncall: oncall will apply a temporary rule: force region-local kv affinity for dedicated pools unless explicit cross-region flag is set. Rolling to canary now.
sre-bot: ACTION_CREATED: CR#5501 - add nat-pair binding for cross-region flows + telemetry: per-flow nat_symmetry_ratio and per-tenant cross_region_error_rate.
anya: Also add detection: alert if cross_region_error_rate > 0.5% for >5m.
marco: Long term we should: 1) prefer internal VPC endpoints for kv replicas so we avoid SNAT across regions; 2) implement a lightweight cross-region proxy that maintains symmetric NAT; 3) update SDK guidance to prefer local-replica reads for latency-sensitive calls.
drew: Agreed. For cost analysis: nat-pair per tenant vs more robust routing rules vs proxy. I'll draft numbers.
ops-bot: RESOLVED: cross-region-egress-unstable 12 - region-local affinity enforced, errors dropped. Monitor 1h.
marco: Follow-ups: telemetry PR, CR#5501 implementation plan, SDK note, and a runnable runbook "cross-region-nat-symmetry". I'll file postmortem stub after monitoring window.
